narrative.overview:
The page reads as a morning edition. A mineral field holds the nameplate and the lead; stone paper holds the services and the demos. Schibsted Grotesk, self-hosted, sets the nameplate, the display line, and the body. One amber thread is the only accent, and it stays on the field.

The pace is an edition's. A display headline, a short deck, and one pill. Services and demos are hairline indexes. The process carries the same thread down a rail beside the steps. Ground changes do the work of depth. The browser frame is the single lifted object, and it crosses from the field onto the paper.

Selection, the caret, the scrollbar, and the focus ring come from the field, the paper, and the thread. Motion is one gesture. The thread draws along the nameplate, the browser opens from a clip, and the process rail fills as the steps move through the viewport. With reduced motion, or if the motion library does not load, those three are already complete.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds: mineral field for the nameplate, lead, process, and close; stone paper for services and demos
Deep field for the pressed field button and the colophon
One amber thread, only on the field
One self-hosted grotesque, variable weights 400–700, no italic
Pills for actions, square bands, 1px indexes
One shadow, under the browser frame
Focus, selection, caret, and scrollbar taken from the palette

rules.name: The Thread Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on the field. It marks the nameplate, field focus, field underlines, process numerals, and the process rail. It is never a text fill. On stone paper it falls to about 1.7:1, so the build keeps it off the paper entirely.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is a tint of the same mineral hue. Soft ink on paper, mist on the field. A neutral gray is not a text color in this system.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Schibsted Grotesk is the only voice. The loaded file is the Latin variable, weights 400–700, self-hosted, with `font-display: swap`. Avenir Next, then Segoe UI, then a generic sans, are the fallbacks. Italic is not loaded.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Body stops at 65ch. The deck stops at 40rem. Service lines and the lead caption stop at 62ch. Display tracking is −0.035em. Shared heading tracking is −0.03em. Display size ends at 6rem.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: The lead browser belongs to both grounds. It overlaps the paper by 3.25rem. Its top corners are 14px. Its bottom edge is square where it meets the paper. The caption begins 4.15rem below that crossing.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Bands, rows, pills, and the nameplate cast no shadow. A surface that needs to separate changes ground. The browser shadow is the only exception, and it stays on that frame.

rules.name: The Pill and Hairline Rule
rules.body: A pill means an action. An index is a square row closed by a 1px line: ink at 16% on paper. The rail track and the resting menu border use bright paper at 34%.

rules.name: The Field Focus Rule
rules.body: The focus ring is 2px, offset 3px. On paper it is the field. On the nameplate, the lead, and any field band it is the thread. The skip link uses the focus event itself to come back into view, because it is hidden until then.

dos: Do print the nameplate, the lead, the process, and the close on the mineral field, the colophon on deep field, and the services and demos on stone paper.
Do keep the amber thread on the field: the 3px nameplate rule, field focus, field underlines, process numerals, and the process rail.
Do use a bright-paper pill on the field and a field pill on paper, both at a 48px minimum height.
Do separate index rows with a 1px hairline, ink at 16% on paper.
Do theme selection (field ground, bright paper text), the caret (field), and the scrollbar (field thumb, paper track, 12px).
Do leave the nameplate thread, the browser, and the process rail fully drawn when motion is reduced.
donts: Don't set the thread as text, or place it on paper. Against stone paper it is about 1.7:1.
Don't add a second accent, a gray for secondary text, or a second type family. Italic is not loaded.
Don't shadow bands, rows, or pills. The browser frame is the only shadow.
Don't turn service or project indexes into cards. They are square rows with a hairline.
Don't round the bottom of the lead browser. The square edge is the seam with the paper.
